items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Cornette would probably take a solo, or a cornet would take a solo.

ctx.x: Oh yeah? Sure, it was all ensemble too. All ensemble? Sure. There was no solos. Cornette would probably take a solo, or a cornet would take a solo. They were about the only two who used to take the solos.
Well, a cornet band at that time, you didn't take down the drier lift, but you didn't take down the whole chorus.
